You can keep up-to-date with us on social media.

WELCOME TO GOALS SOUTHEND

In April 2023, GOALS Southend became the latest addition to the GOALS estate. After 6 months of refurbishment, we opened the doors to the community offering football for all on 5, 7, 8, and 11-a-side arenas, kids parties, corporate events, functions, and hall hire. 

Our artificial surface, ProTurf® is as close to grass as you can get. It's designed specifically for small-sided football, and completely exclusive to GOALS. It delivers natural gameplay, pace and is easier on your joints allowing you to play for longer.

Goals are the leading provider of small-sided football in the UK, and as we #AcceptNoSubstitutes when it comes to customer experience we also upgraded the 5-a-side pitches to include stadia rebound boards!

We didn't stop with the arena refurb. The entire site has been completely modernised and renewed; including a brand-new sports lounge, complete with a fully-stocked sports bar.

LEAGUES AHEAD

Is your team looking for competitive, weekly games? You've come to the right place.

We offer professional-run football leagues with dedicated league managers, committed teams of all abilities, GOALS referees, and great winner's prizes are up for grabs! 

Leagues available: 

Monday 7-a-side
Monday 5-a-side
Student 6-a-side
Tuesday 7-a-side
Tuesday 5-a-side
Wednesday 7-a-side
Wednesday 5-a-side
Ladies 5-a-side
Thursday 7-a-side

So… How does it work? Simply get your team together and play a trial game at a reduced cost; this is where you get a taste of the GOALS League experience, and we evaluate your team's ability before allocating you to an appropriate division. 

Are you game? Tap below to get started. 

TRIAL GAME
PLANNING A PARTY?

A dedicated in-house events team is on hand to help with catering, decorations, and music options, leaving you free to relax and enjoy your occasion.

Our modern function suite is available on selected weekdays, Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays. With a hall capacity of 120 people, including kids, you won't have to compromise on your guest list. A late license is available on request, for free so you can party into midnight. Hassle-free function hire from as little as a refundable £150 deposit.

Hall hire, event hire, weddings, engagement parties, retirement parties, or milestone birthdays, whatever your event, we can look after you. 

Get in touch below and let us take care of the rest.

ENQUIRE
WEEKEND VIBES

You made it through the week. Fancy a treat? 

Join us in our sports lounge for Pizza Friday! Alongside our yummy weekend food and drinks menu, we are offering Chicago Town pizzas from 5:30pm, until close.

Margherita, Pepperoni, and Meat Feast are available for only £9.95, served with a smile (and an optional alcoholic beverage or two) to get your weekend off to a great start.

No booking required, see you on Fri-yay!  

KICKABOUT

Maybe you're not a planner, after a casual Kickabout with a few friends or, you're a parent trying to keep your children active; our Kickabout sessions are a flexible way to level up. Simply get your mates together, hit the pitch, and play football.

Pitches are available from the early morning, on school holidays right through to late night sessions on fully enclosed arenas from only £5 per player on 5-a-side or £7 per player on 7-a-side.

Stay fit with your friends
Play when it suits you
1 hour pitch time guaranteed
No booking required
No commitment

*Pitch exclusivity isn't guaranteed, this is subject to pitch availability.

KIDS FOOTBALL PARTIES

Enjoy an unforgettable kids party at GOALS whatever the weather, on our outdoor all-weather ProTurf pitches. Whether you choose our Premier Party or prefer to Build Your Own, your little football star is guaranteed a day to remember.

Parties are priced based on a minimum of 10 children, with the option to add more guests for an additional cost – either when booking or closer to the big day.

Every party takes place in a fun, safe and fully supervised environment, giving you peace of mind while the kids enjoy non-stop football action.

And that's just the start – from Panini goodies and party bags to trophies, medals, and tasty upgrades like pizza, ice cream and slushies, there are loads of ways to make their big day even more unforgettable.

FIND OUT MORE
20% STUDENT DISCOUNT

Being a student is tough enough — your football shouldn't be. That's why we've teamed up with Student Beans to give you exclusive student savings on pitch bookings at every GOALS club.*

Simply sign up below with Student Beans, grab your one-off discount code, select a student discounted pitch and enter your code at checkout to unlock your student discount.

Tap below to get started.
